functionality: Batch Send Report, View Delivery Status
description: Covers bulk delivery logging and delivery-status listing on top of the already-existing single-send contract.

reused_apis.note: Already covers 'Send report' (single delivery). Batch Send below reuses the exact same per-item validation, looped.

body.deliveries: array, required, min 1 item - each item: { reportId: uuid required, deliveryType: enum required (PRINT|EMAIL|SMS|WHATSAPP|PORTAL), recipientType: enum required (PATIENT|DOCTOR|REFERRAL|COLLECTION_CENTER|LAB), recipientName: string optional, recipientContact: string optional }

validation: deliveries must be a non-empty array
each item's reportId must reference an existing report (NOT NULL FK) - see API-105
each item's deliveryType/recipientType must be valid enum values - see API-105
a report-level failure does not abort the batch; failures are reported per-item in the response

response.error: deliveries must contain at least one item

query_parameters.deliveryStatus: enum, optional - PENDING | SENT | FAILED | DELIVERED

validation: reportId must exist and belong to organization + branch

errors.condition: reportId not found / not in organization+branch scope

constraints: delivery_type CHECK IN (PRINT, EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP, PORTAL)
recipient_type CHECK IN (PATIENT, DOCTOR, REFERRAL, COLLECTION_CENTER, LAB)

notes: Net-new contract; no e2e-validation or api_contracts_test coverage exists yet for these two operations.
